one_line: A royal-regulated doctor from the Arthashastra’s imagined Mauryan-era bureaucracy in Pataliputra.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, lean-medium build with a calm, disciplined posture.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium-brown North Indian complexion, straight nose, sharp dark-brown eyes with a focused gaze, thin neatly groomed moustache, a small vertical tilak in dull red on the forehead, default expression composed and observant with a hint of sternness.
appearance.hair: Black hair oiled and drawn back into a low, neatly tied knot at the nape, front hair smoothed with no loose strands; a plain off-white cotton headband wraps horizontally around the head, leaving the knot visible at the back.
appearance.costume: Era-appropriate Mauryan court physician attire: a knee-length off-white cotton uttariya wrapped over a short-sleeved, close-fitting, collarless tunic in muted indigo, the uttariya draped from the left shoulder across the torso and around the waist like a sash; below, a calf-length, straight-paneled dhoti in light beige with a narrow maroon border, pleated neatly in front and tied high at the waist; simple brown leather sandals; a narrow woven cotton belt in dull maroon securing a small cloth pouch; minimal jewellery: a single thin copper bangle on the right wrist and small copper stud earrings; a folded palm-leaf manuscript tucked at the back of the belt, edges visible.
appearance.signature: A long, narrow wooden physician’s case—dark brown polished wood with a sliding lid—carried in his left hand and hanging from a simple shoulder strap, containing metal probes and small clay jars, plus a slender measuring rod marked with subtle notches held in his right hand to symbolize regulated, state-supervised practice.

ref_desc: A composed medium-brown man in his early 30s with an oval face, neat black hair in a low knot and off-white headband, wearing an off-white uttariya over a muted indigo tunic and beige dhoti with maroon border, brown sandals, minimal copper jewellery, carrying a dark-brown wooden physician’s case on a strap and a slender measuring rod, in a palette of off-white, muted indigo, light beige, dull maroon and dark brown.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Mauryan-era state physician from Pataliputra: a medium-brown man in his early 30s with an oval face, sharp dark eyes, thin moustache and a small dull-red vertical tilak, black hair oiled back into a low knot and wrapped with a plain off-white headband. He wears an off-white cotton uttariya wrapped over a close-fitting, short-sleeved, collarless muted indigo tunic, the uttariya crossing the chest and looping around the waist, and a straight-paneled calf-length light beige dhoti with a narrow dull maroon border, pleated neatly in front and tied at the waist. On his feet are simple brown leather sandals; at his waist a narrow dull maroon woven belt holds a small cloth pouch and a visible folded palm-leaf manuscript. He has minimal jewellery: a thin copper bangle on his right wrist and small copper stud earrings. In his left hand he carries a long, narrow dark-brown polished wooden physician’s case with a sliding lid, hanging from a plain strap over his shoulder, and in his right hand a slender measuring rod with subtle notches, held with quiet authority. Use a restrained palette of off-white, muted indigo, light beige, dull maroon and dark brown, and present front, side and back views to clearly show hair, drapery, belt, sandals and the physician’s case and rod.
